versions.title: UI Responsiveness, Refresh Animations & Stability Improvements

changes.description: Refresh Button Animations: Added smooth spinning animations and loading feedback for refresh buttons across HR (Staff Management, Details, Attendance, Payroll) and Custom Documents modules.
Data Synchronization & Cache Busting: Added cache-busting requests and automated search field synchronization when refreshing lists to prevent stale cached data.
Keyboard Shortcuts: Added universal Ctrl+R shortcut support to refresh data across Staff Management, Employee Details, Attendance, Payroll, and Custom Document views.
Document Module Refresh Animation: Resolved issue where custom documents refresh button failed to animate due to missing keyframe definitions and icon class bindings.
TypeScript Global Scope Isolation: Wrapped voucher frontend controller in an IIFE to eliminate global namespace collisions and duplicate function implementation compiler errors.
Stock Table Layout: Enhanced stock overview layout with responsive table formatting, improved overflow scrolling, and better container spacing.
Company Information Controls: Fixed company info export button visibility handling during edit mode.
